description:
FILED s543q (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28, CODE 6a1301ed = MAIN-READY-114 + records, v2-16500) by the Rosetta census B (docs/rosetta-plan.md section 6b; #2104).

THE SHAPES (neutral reproducers, run on the tree, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):

    my %h;
    my $y = pop @{ $h{k} || [] };
    print exists($h{k}) ? "viv" : "none", "\n";
    perl: none
    PCL : viv          (exit 0, nothing on stderr: SILENT)

    my @b;
    my $x = shift @{ $b[-1] // [] };
    print defined($x) ? "d" : "u", " ", scalar(@b), "\n";
    perl: u 0
    PCL : Modification of non-creatable array value attempted, subscript -1      (exit 255)

WHERE (emitted Lisp): `(p-pop (p-cast-@ (p-|| (p-gethash-box %h "k") (make-p-box ...))))` and
`(p-shift (p-cast-@ (p-// (p-aref-box @b -1) ...)))` -- the BOX accessors (p-gethash-box, p-aref-box: the lvalue/vivifying
fetch a modifying deref uses) are applied THROUGH the `||` / `//` to its left operand.  The lvalue context belongs to the
`@{...}` operand as a whole; `EXPR || DEFAULT` is not an lvalue in perl, so its operands are plain reads.  (#165 is the inverse
-- a `for (A || B)` alias that perl DOES make writable -- and is not this.)

CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (taken): 1093 with the element read first (`my $t = @bins ? $bins[-1] : undef; shift @{ $t // [] }`)
no longer dies; it then differs by its second cause, #5463 (`$bins[shift]`, a builtin name autoquoted as a subscript), and with
that spelled `$bins[shift()]` too it is byte-identical to perl.

PROGRAMS: 1093-Priority-queue.
subject: SILENT WRONG: a `||` / `//` DEFAULT inside a modifying array dereference fetches its left ELEMENT as an LVALUE -- `pop @{ $h{k} || [] }` CREATES `$h{k}` (perl leaves it absent) and `shift @{ $a[-1] // [] }` on an empty array dies "Modification of non-creatable array value attempted, subscript -1" (Rosetta 1093)
triage_reason: `@{ EXPR || [] }` is the ordinary "default to an empty list" idiom; the left operand of `||` / `//` is an rvalue (perlop), IN by docs/supported-subset.md section 3
